mapping.summary: Group reporting, intercompany reconciliation, settlement and invoicing across BC companies and tenants.
claims: Connects companies in different BC tenants through a secure API
Group financial reports with a column per company, group totals, ownership percentages and drill-down
Matrix of balances between all company pairs, with overdue amounts and reconciliation status
Analyses differences from exchange rates, rounding, bank fees, missing documents and one-sided postings
FIFO-based settlement proposals with audit trail
Recurring intercompany invoices from templates on both sides
Tracks intra-group loans and cash pooling
Group-wide customer and vendor exposure with Excel export
One scheduled task aggregates the whole environment
Does not change operational transactions or duplicate master data
